reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining OneCoin and a mining fund as a way to receive OneCoin rewards. It adds a time-sensitive participation claim, a purported profit outcome from holding the coins for a year, and a projected increase to 2.5 to 5 euros within a year.

citations.quote: If you join in time, you do it when the difficulty is reduced.
What's beneficial to do is to actually speculate the market, to store the coins for at least a year and so you will have a real profit.
Markets can be stored for a while in order to make profit from selling them or from making a trade.
In the coin, mining is done through tokens what every investor receives in their wallet.
Any member can join if they want to mine, only if they want to.

opening.argument: The presentation uses conditional, qualified language rather than promising a certain return. It says participants may join only by choice, describes future value as an aspiration, and explicitly presents the projected price as something the speaker hopes for. The discussion also acknowledges that mining becomes harder as participation increases and that profit depends on market activity and timing. That combination is more consistent with an informational market forecast containing uncertainty than with a deceptive guarantee. The statement about holding coins refers to what is considered beneficial, but it does not establish that every viewer will profit or that loss is impossible.

citations.quote: Any member can join if they want to mine, only if they want to.
We are aiming to start to value OneCoin since the 50 cents amount and we hope that in a year this will be between 2,5 to 5 euros per piece
This has not been a surprising growth as is the rate of Bitcoin, but it hasn't been healthy, but is a slow growth of stability and safety of the cryptocurrency currency

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited timing and holding language should be read alongside the presentation's qualified forecast, not as a guarantee. “If you join in time” describes a claimed relationship between participation and mining difficulty, while “we hope” expressly marks the price range as an expectation. The quoted material does not say that profit is certain, risk-free, or available to every viewer.

citations.quote: If you join in time, you do it when the difficulty is reduced.
we hope that in a year this will be between 2,5 to 5 euros per piece.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Qualification does not neutralize the economic invitation. The speaker still tells viewers that storing the coins for at least a year will produce “real profit” and says stored coins can be sold or traded for profit. Calling the price a hope limits certainty about the amount, but the central profit pathway remains affirmative rather than merely analytical.

citations.quote: What's beneficial to do is to actually speculate the market, to store the coins for at least a year and so you will have a real profit.
Markets can be stored for a while in order to make profit from selling them or from making a trade.

opening.argument: The video's primary presentation is an explanation of how cryptocurrency mining is supposed to work. Its title explicitly identifies a presentation and definition of mining, and the speaker introduces the subject by saying they will explain how mining is done. The slides are organized as instructional material about mining, blockchain visibility, mining pools, algorithms, and the changing difficulty of finding coins. The visual material is likewise headed as an explanation of how mining is done. Discussing possible market consequences within a technical tutorial does not by itself convert the whole presentation into a solicitation.

citations.quote: Onecoin Presentation Definition Mining
in this video we will talk about mining how is mining done
Now come on, let's see what mining is.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats selected economic remarks as if they define the video's main purpose, but the supplied title and structure identify a mining presentation. References to holding or trading appear within an explanation of how tokens, mining, and market value are connected. The presentation also explains blockchain records and mining difficulty, which are educational subjects rather than proof of a solicitation.

citations.quote: Onecoin Presentation Definition Mining
Now lets see how do we know when a coin used to be mined?

This fact, in cryptocurrencies, Just like all transactions As cryptocurrency these factors are important, because this creates a trust in the respective currency And creates the transparency that leads to the trust

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A tutorial format does not change what the tutorial recommends. The speaker moves from explaining mining to advising viewers to speculate, store coins for at least a year, and expect profit from selling or trading. The technical discussion therefore functions as support for an investment-related participation pathway, not merely detached instruction.

citations.quote: What's beneficial to do is to actually speculate the market, to store the coins for at least a year and so you will have a real profit.
Tokens with one coin can be exchanged, participating in mining.
Markets can be stored for a while in order to make profit from selling them or from making a trade.

opening.argument: The material describes a proposed cryptocurrency activity and the practical services associated with it, not a demonstrated scam mechanism. It says the company will provide mining resources and equipped computers, and that people who do not want to mine can keep or exchange tokens. Participation is expressly optional. The supplied presentation does not show a deposit demand, credential request, downline-income structure, or guaranteed payout. It presents an exchange and mining arrangement whose operation and market value would still need independent assessment, but uncertainty about an external service is not itself proof of fraud.

citations.quote: Those who don't like to mine can keep the tokens or exchange them.
will provide all mining resources, well equipped computers and everyone who wants to apply will be able to join the mining pool.
Any member can join if they want to mine, only if they want to.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference opening identifies token rewards and predicted appreciation, but those features can also describe an ordinary cryptocurrency service or promotional market commentary. Its citations do not establish that viewers must pay a deposit, recruit others, surrender credentials, or receive a guaranteed return. The cited “real profit” statement is an assertion about an expected market outcome, not evidence of a specific fraudulent mechanism.

citations.quote: In the coin, mining is done through tokens what every investor receives in their wallet.
Any member can join if they want to mine, only if they want to.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing-mechanism argument overlooks the mechanism actually described: investors receive tokens for mining, are told to hold them for at least a year, and are told that selling or trading them can yield profit. A scam need not display every possible feature such as credentials or downline recruitment; the token appreciation pathway is itself the relevant economic inducement.
